newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-GOTTI BOOSTS LEAD AFTER TONKOV FALLS.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-GOTTI BOOSTS LEAD AFTER TONKOV FALLS.

text.p: Italian Ivan Gotti extended his race lead in the Giro d'Italia to one minute 32 seconds on Thursday as his chief rival, Russian Pavel Tonkov, fought back from a crash.

Gotti finished 3:08 behind Spain's Jose Rubiera, who won the mountainous 222 kms leg from Predazzo, and 55 seconds ahead of Tonkov who fell on a rain-slicked mountain descent some 90 kms from the finish.
In the last 20 kms and after six mountain climbs Tonkov was 1:23 behind his Italian rival whose overnight advantage was just 37 seconds.

Roberto Conti was second and his fellow Italian Giuseppe Guerini third with Gotti chasing them home. Guerini moves to third overall, six minutes in arrears, replacing his team mate Luc Leblanc of France.
Leblanc quit during this 19th stage, suffering after his crash in Wednesday's time trial.
